title: Character Sheet Editor sheetCuts: the margin left of the front figure is not a gap
description: Fabio's run 2026-10-17 19:13 logged 'sheetCuts measured: no gaps'. The Editor measures the with-head version of the sheet (flowCharacterSheet_069), where the empty strip left of the front figure is wide enough to count as a run; it becomes cut 1 at ~6%, fails the 15-40% check, and the whole measure returns no cuts, so the Tattoos/Accessories back pass falls back to 25%/50%. Fix: sheetCuts counts a run only after a figure. MPI-1086 r44 follow-up.
